services.desc: Learn to play the sport that’s as social as golf and as active as tennis. There’s no better place to learn pickleball than in our state-of-the-art facilities with the best coaches in the business. Whether you’re brand new to pickleball or just looking to build your confidence, our Pickleball 101 class covers all the essentials you need to get started. Taught by certified coaches, each lesson combines instruction with real court time so you can build your skills quickly. Pickleball is similar to tennis, but we champion its differences.
